title: The first shared name estimates overlap
hook: Two sets need the same ordering before their first elements can be compared.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Relate MinHash signature collisions to set Jaccard similarity using the same hash order.

misconception: The smallest numeric member itself estimates set similarity regardless of hash order.
objective: Relate MinHash signature collisions to set Jaccard similarity using the same hash order.

claims.text: The first union element in a shared permutation is uniformly distributed over that union. Both minima match precisely when that first element belongs to the intersection. The exhaustive tiny example therefore equals intersection size divided by union size.
